verdict.rationale: Mercury markets card limits, spend controls and granular user permissions for curbing team spend (docs-10, docs-38). Its Cards API changelog documents managing spending limits and card lifecycle states programmatically (docs-36/52). A long-time customer reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits (comm-1). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which control types exist (e.g. merchant/category restrictions, limit periods), and explicit evidence of assigning cards and limits per employee rather than per card.
